info.title: Magpie x402 API — agent-native lending on Solana (free data endpoints)
info.description: Free, no-payment data and routing endpoints for the Magpie agent-native lending protocol on Solana: live lending-pool state across V1/V3/V4 strategies, the approved-collateral catalog, the permissionless liquidation feed, 24h protocol aggregates, anonymized activity, and loan/wallet lookups. Magpie also exposes paid borrow/repay/deposit/withdraw/liquidate-build and in-vault exit-arming endpoints that settle in native SOL via Magpie's own x402/solana/v1 scheme (not USDC/USDT) — see https://github.com/magpiecapital/magpie-x402 and the catalog at https://x402.magpie.capital/.well-known/x402.json.

get.summary: Fetch LendingPool state for one Magpie strategy version
get.description: Reads the LendingPool Anchor account for one program version. ?version=v1 (memecoin, default) | v3 (RWA) | v4 (exit-order). 15s cache.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Strategy pool to read: v1 (memecoin), v3 (RWA), or v4 (in-vault exit). Defaults to v1.

get.summary: Fetch LendingPool state for all three Magpie strategies
get.description: V1 + V3 + V4 LendingPool state together. Each version is fetched independently; a failed version appears in `partial` and never blanks the others (lane separation).

get.summary: Fetch a single Magpie loan by its on-chain PDA
get.description: Decodes the Loan account, routing to V1/V3/V4 purely from the account owner. Returns program_version, category, and (V4) in-vault exit state + exits_supported.

parameters.name: loanPda
parameters.description: Base58 Solana public key of the loan PDA to fetch.

get.summary: Find Magpie loans by borrower wallet and loan id
get.description: Requires ?borrower= because loan PDAs are seeded by borrower and each program has its own loan_id sequence. Returns a LIST (a borrower can hold the same loan_id in more than one program). For a single unambiguous loan use /api/v1/loan/by-pda/{loanPda}.

parameters.name: loanId
parameters.description: Numeric on-chain loan id (digits only).

parameters.name: borrower
parameters.description: Base58 Solana public key of the borrower wallet that owns the loan.

200.description: { count, loans[] } each tagged with program_version

get.summary: List all Magpie loans owned by a wallet across versions
get.description: Fans getProgramAccounts (borrower memcmp @offset 16) across all three lending programs and decodes each through the pool-separation-safe guard. Each loan is tagged with program_version + category + (V4) exit state. A failed version appears in `partial` and never blanks the rest. Optional ?status=active|repaid|liquidated. 8s cache.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Base58 Solana public key of the wallet whose loans to list.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional filter: active, repaid, or liquidated. Omit to return all.

get.summary: List Magpie loan tier definitions and benefits
get.description: Static protocol constants — fixed 3 tiers (Express / Quick / Standard). 1h cache.

get.summary: Simulate a Magpie borrow without submitting on-chain
get.description: Pure-math quote from caller-supplied prices + the public tier constants. Use ?tier=all to get quotes for all three tiers side-by-side.

parameters.name: mint
parameters.description: Base58 Solana mint of the collateral token to simulate borrowing against.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Collateral amount in base units (integer string, no decimal point).

parameters.name: decimals
parameters.description: Decimals of the collateral mint (1-2 digit integer string).

parameters.name: pricePerTokenUsd
parameters.description: USD price per collateral token used for the simulation.

parameters.name: solPriceUsd
parameters.description: USD price of SOL used to convert the borrow value to lamports.

parameters.name: tier
parameters.description: Loan tier to simulate: express, quick, standard, or all. Defaults to all.

get.summary: Poll the status of a conditional borrow intent
get.description: When status='matched', the response includes partial_signed_tx_b64 ready to sign + submit.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Intent id returned when the conditional borrow intent was created.

delete.summary: Cancel a pending conditional borrow intent

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Intent id of the pending conditional borrow intent to cancel.

get.summary: List conditional borrow intents for a wallet

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Base58 Solana public key of the wallet whose intents to list.

get.summary: List every token approved as Magpie collateral
get.description: Public token registry — mint, symbol, decimals, category. 1h cache. First-touch endpoint for agents discovering what they can borrow against.

get.summary: List Magpie loans at or past their on-chain due time
get.description: Multi-version (V1 memecoin + V3 RWA by default). Sorted most-past-due-first; each loan tagged with program_version. V4 (exit-order) loans auto-sell in-vault and are EXCLUDED by default; pass ?include_v4=true to add them. Optional within_seconds for pre-positioning. Free — the read surface for liquidation-bot agents.

parameters.name: within_seconds
parameters.description: Also include loans due within this many seconds (0-604800). Defaults to 0 (already past due).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of loans to return (1-500). Defaults to 100.

parameters.name: include_v4
parameters.description: Set 'true' to include V4 exit-order loans (excluded by default; they auto-sell in-vault).

200.description: Liquidatable loan list with per-loan program_version + seconds_past_due

get.summary: List anonymized recent Magpie protocol activity
get.description: Last N borrow/repay/liquidate events. Wallets anonymized to Xxxx…Yyyy. No PII. The first-touch 'is this protocol alive' feed for new agents and third-party monitors. Free — 15s cache.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of activity entries to return (1-200). Defaults to 50.

get.description: Active loans, active borrowers, borrow volume and counts over 24h + 1h windows, liquidation counts. Pure numbers, no per-wallet data. Free — 30s cache.

get.summary: List top Magpie wallets by credit score, anonymized
get.description: Top 20 wallets ranked by credit score. Anonymized to Xxxx…Yyyy. Free — 60s cache.

get.summary: Fetch a depositor's Magpie LP position and pool context
get.description: Free. Shares, deposited lamports, current value, yield earned, share-of-pool. Plus pool totals for the caller to compute their own ratios. 10s cache.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Base58 Solana public key of the depositor wallet to read.

post.summary: Modify an armed in-vault exit order on a V4 loan
post.description: Signed envelope (magpie: limit-close-modify/v1, OrderId). Change trigger / slippage / destination / expiry without re-paying — the signature authorizes.

post.summary: Cancel an armed in-vault exit order on a V4 loan
post.description: Signed envelope (magpie: limit-close-cancel/v1, OrderId). A too-late cancel is a 409 no-op (the engine flipped to firing).

get.summary: List armed in-vault exit orders for a wallet
get.description: All armed exit orders for a wallet. Public read of the same data the owner sees in the UI.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Base58 Solana public key of the wallet whose armed exit orders to list.
